research_projects.title: Deep Learning Research for X-ray Diagnosis of Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)
bullets: Segmented X-ray images to isolate lung regions.
Improved diagnostic performance through classification network training.

research_projects.title: Research on SAR Image Analysis and Semantic Segmentation
bullets: Investigated despeckling and scaling methods for SAR data.
Devised generative models and data augmentation for training data acquisition.
Improved SAR segmentation performance through knowledge distillation.

research_projects.title: Open-Vocabulary Zero-Shot Detection for Military Objects
bullets: Conducted collaborative research on open-vocabulary zero-shot detection for military objects.
Studied recognition and detection strategies for unseen military targets.
Built and analyzed experimental pipelines for robust zero-shot understanding.
Investigated vision-language approaches for military AI applications.
